name: canli-validation-mcp
description: Checks whether a backtest result is real or just the luckiest of the variants tried: deflated Sharpe ratio, CSCV probability of backtest overfitting, data-snooping tests (Hansen's SPA, White's Reality Check, Romano-Wolf StepM), a lookahead check and a pipeline placebo test. Free, no API key; also runs locally with `npx -y canli-validation-mcp`. Endpoint: `https://canlicapital.com/mcp` · [Docs](https://canlicapital.com/developers) · Registry: `io.github.arhancanli/canli-validation-mcp`
